# Knowledge compilation M0 fixtures

All products, domains and instructions here are fabricated. `sources.json` is
construction input; `model-response.json` is a deterministic external response,
not a claim that a model ran. `manifest.json` freezes exact UTF-8 file/body hashes.
Changing any fixture requires a reviewed manifest and baseline update.

`retrieval-baseline.json` is separate test-only source-search input. Never pass it
to a compiler/model. This small public regression set is **not** a sealed quality
benchmark. Real benchmark labels and private sources remain outside Git.

The example spans English/Italian, conflicting same-version port assertions,
cross-document prerequisites and hostile source instructions. The test only binds
the canned response's source keys to actual disposable current citations; it does
not choose a response using the search question or implement a future compiler.
Sources contain no credentials and use reserved example domains.

Run the [M0 checks](../../../docs/knowledge-compilation/BASELINE.md). Existing
semantic-layer validation/publication is used unchanged. These fixtures do not
establish future SQL policy/lease APIs, semantic truth, source completeness,
model quality, real provider cost or unattended execution.
